name: 34472 · Ocala, FL
findings: ZIP 34472 (Ocala) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34472 (Ocala) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
